messages:
kevin: main CI is red — deploy-to-prod job failing when cloning private repo model-store. getting access denied 403. Anyone else seeing this? cc @eng-infra

ci-bot: build 7634 failed: job deploy-prod (runner: self-hosted) - git clone https://github.com/redwood/model-store.git - exit code 128
``nfatal: could not read Username for 'https://github.com': No such device or address
HTTP 403
```

neha: I rotated the GHA app install token yesterday for org-level. Did we forget to update the repo secret? :thinking:

miguel: checking now. looks like the deploy runner gets a short-lived token from Vault at secret/gha/model-store. Vault role's policy got tightened this morning (I rolled a small change).

devops-bot: runner-42 IAM logs show KMS:Decrypt denied on key alias/ci-key-redwood. service account 'ci-runner@redwood-prod' missing decrypt permission.

sam: If KMS decrypt fails, Vault can't mint usable tokens. We need kms:Decrypt on that role. I can open a quick PR to add it if someone confirms scope.

kevin: who can update IAM? @neha @miguel

neha: I can add a binding in IAM console but want to confirm scope — grant kms:Decrypt on alias/ci-key-redwood to ci-runner SA only. OK?

miguel: yes, that's correct. Also update Vault role to allow that SA to request leases. After both changes, rerun pipeline.

kevin: can someone rerun the failing workflow? it's blocking the release.

neha: I'll rerun after IAM change. Quick note: if this shows up again, let's bisect commits since token rotation (~6 commits).

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: queued rerun workflow/7634 -> run 7635

oncall-bot: Note: short-term mitigation: use legacy deploy key if you need a hotfix rollback. set env SKIP_VAULT=true in the pipeline to skip secret fetch.

sam: repro command I used locally: 
``
GIT_ASKPASS=echo git clone https://x-access-token:$TOKEN@github.com/redwood/model-store.git
```

miguel: neha — I pushed a tiny perm PR to infra-roles adding kms:Decrypt for ci-runner, description explains limited scope. pinging for approval now.

neha: :thumbsup: will approve and apply, then monitor logs.

kevin: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for updates, will post final status when PROD deploy finishes.
